content.title: Stochastic Training is Not Necessary for Generalization
content.abstract: It is widely believed that the implicit regularization of SGD is fundamental to the impressive generalization behavior we observe in neural networks.  In this work, we demonstrate that non-stochastic full-batch training can achieve comparably strong performance to SGD on CIFAR-10 using modern architectures. To this end, we show that the implicit regularization of SGD can be completely replaced with explicit regularization. Our observations indicate that the perceived difficulty of full-batch training may be the result of its optimization properties and the disproportionate time and effort spent by the ML community tuning optimizers and hyperparameters for small-batch training.
content.one-sentence_summary: Models trained with full-batch gradient descent and explicit regularization can match the generalization performance of models trained with stochastic minibatching.
